name: Local User Account Created (Linux)
description: A local account was added via useradd/adduser. On a server that is not an identity source this is rare and is a common persistence step after initial access.
false_positives: Legitimate onboarding or automation that provisions local accounts (should be allow-listed).
note:
### Triage
- Who ran it (`user.name` / parent session) and what is the new account name?
- New UID 0 or supplementary group `root`/`sudo`/`wheel`? Escalate.
- Correlate with a preceding successful SSH login.
